name: understood-not-seen
description: Turn bookmarks into place ideas without uploading them. Privacy gate in the browser, Qloo taste graph for places.

scripts.test: node --test test/gate.test.mjs test/routing.test.mjs test/sample.test.mjs test/server.test.mjs test/taste.test.mjs test/expand.test.mjs test/calendar.test.mjs test/pwa.test.mjs test/i18n.test.mjs test/names.test.mjs test/design.lock.test.mjs test/limits.test.mjs test/heat.test.mjs test/privacy_copy.test.mjs
scripts.security: gitleaks detect --source . --no-banner --redact && semgrep scan --config p/javascript --config p/nodejs --config p/python --config p/secrets --metrics=off --quiet --error --exclude web/js/icons.js --exclude web/js/rules.js --exclude web/kb . && npm audit
